name: Adaptive Thinking & Leadership (ATL)
description: Multiplayer training simulation developed for U.S. Special Forces to develop adaptive thinking and leadership skills in complex and chaotic operational environments. Published in Raybourn et al. (2005) I/ITSEC proceedings.
evaluation_method: adaptive decision-making assessment, mission performance metrics
general_score_metric: composite mission-performance score (combining objective mission outcomes with adaptive decision-making and leadership assessment metrics)
notes: Published in Raybourn et al. (2005) I/ITSEC (Interservice/Industry Training, Simulation and Education Conference) proceedings.
